commits.headline: fix(hostgen): asm labels on wrapped declarations and on the earlier of two
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
Three units of the NTSC decomp's latest sync were unreadable. A second
declaration that contradicts the first already carried its symbol's
label and got a second one added. A label Clang refuses can sit on a
declaration that runs over several lines, and for "conflicting asm
label" it sits on the earlier declaration the note points at, not on the
error's line. The label is now kept, found across the declaration's
lines, and taken from the note's line when that is where it is.

Co-Authored-By:…

commits.headline: fix(port): the camera's quaternion blend and its matrix as hand C
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
func_001FA5C8 (two quaternions blended by t, the short way round,
normalised) and func_001FA6C0 (a quaternion's rotation as a full 4 x 4
matrix) are hand-written VU0 in retail and had no C, so they did
nothing: a camera switch's blend (holding L1 for the strafe camera, and
letting it go) left the view rows as whatever the buffer held, the
forward vector flipping to straight down and back every few ticks. The
strafe camera now turns behind Ratchet smoothly.

commits.headline: fix(rac1-pal): sqrt and rsqrt take the magnitude, as on the EE and VU0
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The port's sqrt.s/vsqrt stand-in called sqrtf directly, so a negative
argument gave NaN where the console gives the root of its magnitude. A
horny toad's turn spring (func_L00_0025CE58) passes one the first time it
turns, the NaN spread to its position and bounding sphere, and every
camera line query then hit it: a hard camera reset every 36 ticks.
rsqrt.s by zero now saturates like the divide.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.headline: fix(rac1-pal): leave mobys with a non-finite bounding sphere out of collision queries
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
A NaN never compares as outside a query, so such a moby was in every line,
volume and sphere query. The console's floats cannot hold one; on the host
it now blocks nothing instead of everything.

commits.headline: fix(viewer): draw mobys with their rotation rows, as MobyProc does
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
The renderer rebuilt every moby's rotation from its Euler angles. The game
draws from the rows at +0xC0, which MobyBuildMatrix makes from the angles
unless the moby keeps its own (mode 0x100, or an item placed after its
update, as the wrench in Ratchet's hand is: its angles hold no roll), and
which carry the mirror of mode 0x8000. The angles stay as the fallback for
a moby with no rows yet.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.headline: fix(launcher): Discord presence connects again
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
The handshake waited 150 ms, but Discord answers in 0.3 to 5 s, so the
presence never showed. Wait up to 10 s off the UI thread (startup too), read
replies for 2 s, and retry a dead socket only every 15 s. Tested against a
running Discord; core tests, clippy and fmt pass.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
